answer: Summit Auto Lease, Crescent Motor Credit and Apex Lease Co pass lease equity to the customer. Lease equity is the amount by which our offer exceeds the lease buyout. Bluewater Leasing doesn't pay it out and instead applies it to the car the customer buys from Northwind. Harbor Leasing and Ironwood Lease don't allow third-party buyouts. Also, since February 1, 2026, Apex adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount, so Apex customers will get $350 less in equity.
